queer_characters.name: Michael
queer_characters.notes: Michael is Larson's best friend, an out gay man who reveals he is HIV-positive and cannot access the personal happiness Larson takes for granted. Sympathetic and central, but critics noted the film 'views the AIDS crisis from the perspective of a straight male who did not contract the disease,' limiting his interiority.

contributor_notes: Michael is explicitly gay and HIV-positive per the source text. Rep_quality marked 'mixed' based on the cited critical observation that the AIDS crisis is filtered through a straight protagonist's viewpoint. The 'Sunday' sequence references the AIDS epidemic's toll via Rent cast members playing homeless characters. No subtitle/audio languages or creator identities are discussed in the source text. Larson himself is depicted as straight per the plot (girlfriend Susan). Maintainer should verify whether the 'tragic-queer'/AIDS-narrative framing warrants a trope tag — I left it off since Michael survives on screen and the text doesn't state his death.
